npcs.name: Torunn
npcs.idle: My boy Eilif plays the fiddle. He plays it far too well.

npcs.name: Old Skald Hrafn
npcs.idle: Every tune worth playing was stolen from somewhere. Most of the best from water.

npcs.name: Seeress Alfdis
npcs.idle: I read futures. I couldn't read my own apprentice's heart.

npcs.name: Flayer Kolr
npcs.idle: Trolls, witches, gotawitches. I flay what needs flaying.

npcs.name: Huscarl Hallbjorn
npcs.idle: Fort Atla's the King's. Everything south of it is anybody's.

npcs.name: Runecaster Runa
npcs.idle: The staves say the same thing every night. Fire under the ground, in the south.

quests.title: The Nacken's Tune
quests.offer:
My son Eilif is eleven and plays the fiddle better than any skald in Gotar. He learned it in a summer. From the water, he says - from a man who sits on a stone in the black pool and plays, with his feet in the water.

Last night Eilif went back to pay for the lessons. Old [Hrafn] says the nacken's price is always a life. Will you [find Eilif]?

topics.Hrafn: Old Hrafn the skald, by the longhouse. He's heard every story twice.

quests.summary: Torunn's son learned to fiddle from the nacken in the black pool, and has gone back to pay for the lessons.

steps.goal: Ask Old Skald Hrafn about the nacken
steps.say: The nacken teaches the best tunes in the world. And there's always one tune at the end - the one that makes people dance till they drop, and drown in his pool. That's how he's paid. He'll be at the black pool in the south-west. Listen for the [fiddle].

steps.goal: Go to the black pool in the south-west
steps.text: Fiddle-music, faint and wild. The wind is dancing - you'd swear it.
The dancing winds blow apart into nothing. The music falters, then starts again, closer to the water.

steps.goal: Search the bank of the black pool
steps.text: Eilif's fiddle-case, open and empty. Small footprints lead right to the water's edge - and stop.

steps.goal: Face the nacken of the black pool
steps.text: The nacken sinks back into the pool, still fiddling, more slowly. On the bank, a small boy coughs up water.

stages.name: the Nacken of the Black Pool
stages.announce: A pale man rises from the pool, fiddle under his chin, and smiles. 'He came to pay. Don't be rude.'

boss.name: the Nacken of the Black Pool

stages.success: the Nacken of the Black Pool falls.

steps.say:
He was nice. He was really nice. He taught me everything. And then he played the last tune and I was dancing in the water and I couldn't stop.

I know it, now. The [tune]. I can still hear it.

steps.goal: Help Eilif decide about the tune
steps.say:
If I play it, people will dance. Kings would pay for that. I'd be the greatest fiddler in Midgard. But they'd dance till they dropped, if I didn't stop. And I don't know if I would.

Should I [burn the fiddle]? Then I'll forget the tune. And all the others. Or should I [keep it], and be careful forever?

options.say: ...Will you hold my hand while it burns? ...Thank you. It's gone. They're all gone. I can't remember a single one.
I'll be careful. I'll be so careful. I'll never play the last one. Never.

steps.say:
He burned it? His fiddle? He loved that fiddle more than he loves me.

He can't play a note now. He sat in the kitchen this morning and tried, on his father's old one, and he couldn't. He laughed. He actually laughed. Thank you.

He's home, and he's playing. Better than ever.

Last night at the hall, everybody danced and nobody wanted to stop. He stopped. He did. I saw his face when he did. I'll be watching him every night of my life.

quests.title: The Stolen Rune-Stave
quests.offer:
My apprentice Hild stole my rune-stave - the one with the old blood-runes, the ones I swore never to use - and went south to the gotawitches. To learn what I wouldn't teach her.

The seers' law is clear. A seer who takes the blood-runes is branded and cast out. Will you [find Hild]? Flayer [Kolr] has seen the gotawitches' runestone.

topics.Kolr: Flayer Kolr, by the stables. Rude, but he knows the south woods.

quests.summary: Seeress Alfdis's apprentice stole her rune-stave of forbidden blood-runes and went to the gotawitches.

steps.goal: Ask Flayer Kolr about the gotawitches
steps.say: The gotawitches? South, past the woods, at the old runestone. They've seithr orbs floating round it like fireflies - kill those first, or they'll blind you. Your seer's girl went down there two days ago. I didn't stop her. I'm a flayer, not a [nursemaid].

steps.goal: Go south to the gotawitches' woods
steps.text: Lights drift between the trees - orbs of seithr, humming. Beyond them, the runestone glows red.
Alfdis's stave, planted in the earth before the stone and hung with fresh blood. Hild's blood, by the size of the cut. The rite's begun.
The gotawitch falls, and the runestone's light goes out. A girl sits in the circle with her arms bleeding, crying.

stages.name: Gotawitch Svanhvit
stages.announce: A gotawitch with a face like a pretty skull steps out of the stone. 'The girl came to me. The blood's half-poured. You're interrupting.'

steps.say:
She wouldn't teach me. She said I wasn't ready. I wanted to SEE. I wanted to see the real threads, not the pretty ones.

I saw them. I wish I hadn't. Take me back. Let her [brand me]. I deserve it.

She's back. And she used them - I can see it in her eyes.

The law says brand and exile. The law was written by people like me, for girls like her. I could [keep the law]. Or I could [take the blame] - say I taught her, and be branded myself. I'm old. She isn't. Which? I need someone else to say it.

options.say: Then the law. I'll do it gently. I'll do it myself. She'll go to Myrkwood; I have friends there. Gods forgive me.
Yes. Yes. It was my stave and my teaching and my fault. I'll go. She'll take my seat. She'll be better than me. She'll have to be.

law.text: Take this. You saved her life, whatever comes.

blame.text: Take this. I won't need it where I'm going.

quests.title: Wolf Nippers
quests.offer:
The wolf nippers on the north lakes have grown bold - whole packs coming down to the fort's walls at dusk. Something's pushing them out of the west.

Will you [thin the packs]?
quests.summary: Wolf nippers have grown bold on Gotar's north lakes, pushed out of the west.

steps.goal: Thin the wolf nipper packs about 80 m south-west of Huscarl Hallbjorn

steps.say: Fewer. They're running from the west - from Svealand, where the snow came in summer.

quests.title: The Fish-Catchers
quests.offer:
The hobgoblins on the lakes cut the fort's nets and steal the catch. Not the worst thing in Gotar, but the men are hungry.

Will you [drive them off]?
quests.summary: Hobgoblin fish-catchers cut Fort Atla's nets on Gotar's north lakes.

steps.goal: Drive off the hobgoblin fish-catchers about 160 m south of Huscarl Hallbjorn

steps.say: Fish for supper. You're popular in the barracks.

quests.title: The Wildlings
quests.offer:
Wildlings have made camp by the lakes. They've never come this far east. Break the camp - and if one will talk, ask why.

Will you [break the camp]?
quests.summary: Wildlings have camped on Gotar's north lakes, further east than they have ever come.

steps.goal: Break the wildling camp about 230 m south of Huscarl Hallbjorn

steps.text: A crude drawing: a great wolf with its jaws open over a moon, and the wildlings running away from it, east.

steps.say: A wolf eating the moon. That's the Blodfelag's story, out of West Svealand. If even the wildlings are running from it...

quests.title: The Drowned
quests.offer:
A ship went down off the east shore last winter. Now its drowned walk the beach every night, looking for land they can't reach.

Will you [give them rest]?
quests.summary: The drowned of a wrecked ship walk Gotar's east shore every night.

steps.goal: Give the drowned souls rest about 370 m east of Old Skald Hrafn

steps.say: Rest, then. I'll make them a verse. Every drowned man deserves a verse.

quests.title: What the Ship Carried
quests.offer:
The ship's oarsmen still row, out there on the wreck, though the ship goes nowhere. I want to know where she was going - and what she carried, that the sea wouldn't let her keep.

Bring friends. Will you [board the wreck]?
quests.summary: The skeletal crew of a wreck off Gotar's east shore still row; nobody knows what the ship was carrying.

steps.goal: Fight through the skeletal crew about 380 m south-east of Old Skald Hrafn

clue.name: a chest in the flooded hold

steps.text: The chest is full of dragon-scales - red, and warm, every one. A tally-stick in svartalf runes: 'For the Mother's priests in the north. Paid in gold at the Gotar post.'

steps.say:
Dragon-scale. Shipped north, to 'the Mother's priests'. There's only one dragon in Midgard old enough to be anyone's mother - Gjalpinulva, under Malmohus.

Runecaster Runa at Nalliten will want to know. The staves have been saying 'fire in the south' for a month.

quests.title: The Trade Road
quests.offer:
The svartalf outcasts on the trade road used to sell iron. Now they sell scale - and they've started taking travellers, for 'the Mother'.

Will you [clear the road]?
quests.summary: Svartalf outcasts on Gotar's trade road sell dragon-scale and take travellers for 'the Mother'.

steps.goal: Clear the svartalf outcasts from the trade road about 640 m west of Runecaster Runa

steps.say: 'The Mother.' The staves called her that too. The dragon's waking, and she's buying friends.

quests.title: The Scale-Traders
quests.offer:
The scale-traders camp beside the old svartalf post, under guard. Their ledger will tell us who's buying and who's selling.

Will you [take the ledger]?
quests.summary: Svartalf scale-traders camp under guard beside the old svartalf post on Gotar's trade road.

steps.goal: Break the scale-traders' guards about 720 m west of Runecaster Runa

clue.name: a ledger in a scale-bound cover

steps.text: Every page: scale sold north, gold paid south. The buyers: 'the drakulv of Malmohus, by the Hierophant's word'. And at the end, in a different hand: 'Myrkwood. The old volva at Galplen knows the Mother's name. See to her.'

steps.say:
The Hierophant. The drakulv have a high priest now. And they're after a volva in Myrkwood - an old seer who knows the dragon's true name.

That's a name you don't let a cult take. Kill their preacher, then get word to Galplen.

quests.title: The Dragon-Preacher
quests.offer:
The dragon-preacher at the scale-traders' camp - he's the one who turned the outcasts. Without him, they're just traders again.

Bring friends. Will you [silence the preacher]?
quests.summary: A dragon-preacher turned the svartalf outcasts of Gotar's trade road to the drakulv cult.

steps.goal: Silence the dragon-preacher about 720 m west of Runecaster Runa

steps.say: Silenced. The camp will scatter. But the scale-caravans still run up the road - you'll see one, sooner or later. The Huscarls will want a hand when you do.

quests.title: The Restless Hosts
quests.offer:
The hosts of the hills - wind and earth - have always been here. But they're restless. They're attacking anything that walks the hills.

Will you [quiet them]?
quests.summary: The hosts of wind and earth in Gotar's southern hills have grown restless.

steps.goal: Quiet the hosts of the wind about 110 m east of Eilif
Quiet the hosts of the earth

steps.say: Quieter. They're restless because the ground is warm. The ground's never warm, here.

quests.title: Pooks on the Coast
quests.offer:
The perfidious pooks on the east coast have been luring travellers off the cliffs. Used to be pranks. Now they want blood.

Will you [hunt them]?
quests.summary: The perfidious pooks of Gotar's east coast lure travellers off the cliffs.

steps.goal: Hunt the perfidious pooks about 190 m east of Flayer Kolr

steps.say: Good. Pooks I can skin. Dragons I can't.

quests.title: The Warm Vale
quests.offer:
Carrion eaters gather in the south-east vale. They're feeding on something that died there - big things, all burnt.

Will you [go and look]?
quests.summary: Carrion eaters gather over something burnt in Gotar's south-east vale.

steps.goal: Clear the carrion eaters about 820 m east of Eilif

steps.text: Elk and bear, all burnt from the inside, and the earth under them glassy. Small clawed tracks lead south, toward Myrkwood and Malmohus.

steps.say: Burnt from inside. Drakelings. They're coming up from the south. Hild at the seith circle will know more.

quests.title: Envy Drakelings
quests.offer:
Envy drakelings on the southern edge. They covet everything - gold, fire, the light itself - and they eat what they can't take.

Will you [drive them back]?
quests.summary: Envy drakelings creep up Gotar's southern edge from Myrkwood and Malmohus.

steps.goal: Drive back the envy drakelings about 200 m south-west of Hild

steps.say: Back. For now. The dragon's spawn don't come north on their own. Something called them.

quests.title: The Turned Circle
quests.offer:
Half the seithkona at the circle have turned - they sing to the dragon now, with the gotawitches. They called the drakelings.

Bring friends. Will you [break the turned circle]?
quests.summary: Half the seithkona at Gotar's seith circle have turned to singing for the dragon, with the gotawitches.

steps.goal: Break the gotawitches about 20 m south of Hild

clue.name: a seith-staff laid on the stone

steps.text: The staff is carved with the dragon's long coils, and at the head, a name half-scraped away: GJALP- ... and then, 'the volva at Galplen keeps the rest'.

steps.say:
They were trying to finish the name. To call her by it - a dragon called by her true name wakes all the way.

The volva in Myrkwood. Everyone wants her. Go to Galplen - and go carefully. Myrkwood isn't Gotar.
